user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform, with the platform lifting approximately 80-100 mm and supporting about 1 kg, while being enclosed, safe, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
product_intent: A compact desktop device with an external hand crank that operates an internal platform mechanism capable of lifting a payload of approximately 1 kg through a vertical distance of approximately 80-100 mm within an enclosed housing.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop lifting box
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform
The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm
The platform should support a payload of approximately 1 kg
The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed
